title: Holocron plugin entry
description: One plugin in Holocron: plugins/<Id>.json, and each item of Plugins in repo.json.

Id.description: The plugin's id, the same as Id in its manifest.json and the name of its folder and main DLL.

Version.description: The version in the zip's manifest.json, like 1.2.0.

ApiLevel.description: The Ashla plugin API level the plugin was built for, from the manifest.

License.description: SPDX id of the plugin's license. It must be compatible with the AGPL-3.0.

Source.description: https address of the plugin's source code.

Download.description: https address of the release zip.

Sha256.description: SHA-256 of the release zip, lowercase hex.

Files.description: The Files map from the zip's manifest.json: each file's path and SHA-256.

Changes.description: One line about what's new in this version, shown next to the update in Ashla.
